title: ToolBench Mini: Evaluating Repeated Tool Calls
abstract: We introduce a benchmark for LLM agents that must plan and execute sequences of tool calls. Tasks require retrieving information, checking intermediate results and recovering from a failed tool. We report completion rate and error recovery across several agent policies.

title: Tomato Leaf Image Classification with a Small Network
abstract: We train a compact image classifier to identify tomato leaf diseases from photographs. The study compares classification accuracy and model size on a leaf-image dataset. It contains no language-model agent tasks.

title: KV Compression for Long-Context Inference
abstract: We compress the key-value cache used by a language model during long-context inference. Evaluation measures memory savings, latency and language-model quality. The method does not introduce a benchmark for tool-using agents.
